We are a deeply technical, execution\-driven organization that values ownership, collaboration, and high standards. Our engineers, product leaders, and go\-to\-market teams work closely together — in person and across functions — to build systems that scale in the real world. * Leverage enterprise data, market data, and user interactions to build intelligent and personalized agent experiences.

**Qualifications**
* Knowledge and passion in machine learning algorithms, Gen AI, LLMs, and natural language processing (NLP).

* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, and experience with machine learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**RTO policy for employees based near our Santa Clara, CA office are expected to work from the office 3 days per week,**

 Eightfold.ai provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran or disability status.

title: Software Engineer I - AI/ML, AWS Neuron Distributed Training
description_preview:
**Description**
 Annapurna Labs designs silicon and software that accelerates innovation. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable us to tackle unprecedented technical challenges and deliver solutions that help customers change the world. AWS Neuron is the complete software stack powering AWS Trainium (Trn2/Trn3\), our cloud scale Machine Learning accelerators and we are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our ML Distributed Training team.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for the development, enablement, and performance optimization of large scale ML model training across diverse model families. This includes massive scale pre\-training and post\-training of LLMs with Dense and Mixture\-of\-Experts architectures, Multimodal models that are transformer and diffusion based, and Reinforcement Learning workloads. You will work at the intersection of ML research and high performance systems, collaborating closely with chip architects, compiler engineers, runtime engineers and AWS solution architects to deliver cost\-effective, performant machine learning solutions on AWS Trainium based systems.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You will contribute to the design and implementation of distributed training solutions for large\-scale ML models running on Trainium instances. A significant part of your work will involve extending and optimizing popular distributed training frameworks including FSDP, torchtitan, and Hugging Face libraries for the Neuron ecosystem.
   

  

 A core focus of this role involves developing and optimizing mixed\-precision and low\-precision training techniques. You will work with BF16, FP8, and emerging numerical formats to improve training throughput while maintaining model accuracy and convergence quality. This includes implementing precision\-aware training strategies, loss scaling techniques, and careful gradient management to ensure training stability across reduced precision formats.
   

  

 Beyond precision optimization, you will profile, analyze, and tune end\-to\-end training pipelines to achieve optimal performance on Trainium hardware. You will partner with hardware, compiler, and runtime teams to understand system constraints and unlock new capabilities. Additionally, you will collaborate with AWS solution architects and customers to support the deployment and optimization of training workloads at scale.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Annapurna Labs was a startup company acquired by AWS in 2015, and is now fully integrated. If AWS is an infrastructure company, then think Annapurna Labs as the infrastructure provider of AWS. Our org covers multiple disciplines including silicon engineering, hardware design and verification, software, and operations. AWS Nitro, ENA, EFA, Graviton and F1 EC2 Instances, AWS Neuron, Inferentia and Trainium ML Accelerators, and in storage with scalable NVMe, are some of the products we have delivered, over the last few years.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field, or Bachelor's degree
* 1\+ years of programming experience with at least one software programming language (including academic projects, internships, or research)
* Experience with software development practices including code reviews, source control, testing, and build processes
* Experience with machine learning concepts and at least one ML framework (PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow)

* Experience with computer architecture or hardware\-software co\-optimization
* Experience with distributed systems, libraries, or frameworks
* Familiarity with end\-to\-end model training pipelines
* Previous internship or research experience in ML infrastructure or systems software

title: Software Engineer - Systems
description_preview:
We're building the company which will de\-risk the largest infrastructure build\-out in history.
   

  

 When people finance GPU clusters, the datacenters housing them, and the infrastructure powering them, they need "offtake" \- meaning someone has signed a contract to lease the cluster for a period of time before its even built.
   

  

 Financing a GPU cluster is inherently risky, since margins are thin and volumes are huge. Lenders don't want to take on the risk that cluster developers can't repay their loan, and cluster developers really don't want to risk not selling their cluster. As a result, risk is offloaded to the customer using fixed\-price long\-term contracts.
   

  

 If you don't mitigate this customer risk, there's a bubble. This isn't SaaS anymore \- application layer companies sign multi\-year contracts for computer and inference, but sell to customers on monthly subscriptions. If you mess up a purchase, it's game over: a minor shift in your revenue growth rate might mean the difference between profit or bankruptcy. But what if companies could exit their contract by selling it back to the market?
   

  

 Otherwise, as AI scales, compute only becomes available to folks who can effectively take on that risk. A 2\-person startup in a San Francisco Victorian can't realistically sign a 5\-year take or pay contract on $100m supercomputers. But they may be able to buy the month of liquidity that someone else sold back.
   

  

 So that's what we make: a liquid market for GPU offtake.
   

  

**About The Role**
 At SFC, we are building a GPU market which necessitates bringing the software functionality of the hyperscalers to GPU neoclouds. The work in this role spans provisioning and monitoring bare metal servers with our VM orchestration software all the way to coordinating with our GPU marketplace to enable users to configure the VMs, networks, and storage running on their rented compute. Parts of this include building a Linux OS image with our software tools along with maintaining a tool to ensure that our golden image is able to be consistently (applied across nodes along with per\-data\-center tweaks such as networking configuration), and helping design the API protocol and server that users interact with in order to configure VMs.
   

  

 We primarily use Rust as it enables us to write code that operates at almost every layer of our system (from the web server to coordinating with the kernel, and BIOS), but if you are familiar with a language that requires manual memory management (such as C) and have experience with a higher\-level language then you would also be a great fit.
   

  

**Generally expected knowledge**
 You may not know everything here, but you should be familiar with most of it.
   

  

* You know what virtual machines, and containers are
* You are familiar with syscalls and can explain them an introductory level
* You are familiar with writing multi\-threaded, and ideally co\-operatively scheduled, programs and the associated knowledge
* You are familiar with Linux file descriptors, or the equivalent in other operating systems
* Experience with control or event loops, and ideally RPCs


**Nice to have**
* You are familiar with what virtual, and physical memory is (in the context of page tables)
* Experience with basic assembly
* Understanding of CPU interrupts
* Networking knowledge and the ability to explain how some aspects of packet routing work
* Experience with asynchronous Rust such as "cancel safety" and its interaction with synchronous Rust
* Experience with kernel programming


**Benefits**
 Generous equity grant
   

  

 Team members are offered a competitive salary along with equity in the company

 Yes, we sponsor visas and work permits

title: Founding Software Engineer at well-funded industrial AI startup
description_preview:
**This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.**
 She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.
   

  

 The next step is to speak to Jack.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Founding Software Engineer
   

  

**Salary**
 Not Disclosed
   

  

**Company Description**
 Well\-funded industrial AI startup
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a founding engineer, you will design and implement the core AI systems that automate complex hardware engineering workflows. You will develop novel agents that interpret and manipulate design data, integrating them into production environments for enterprise customers. This high\-impact role offers the chance to build foundational infrastructure for world\-changing industries from the ground up.
   

  

**Location**
 San Francisco, USA
   

  

**Why this role is remarkable**
* Rare opportunity to join a top\-tier VC\-backed startup as one of the first technical hires with significant ownership.
* You will work at the cutting edge of AI, building agents that solve physical\-world engineering challenges rather than just digital tasks.
* The role offers direct influence over the engineering culture, technical architecture, and long\-term product roadmap of the company.


**What You Will Do**
* Design and implement intelligent context management and novel indexing approaches for hardware engineering agents.
* Build and post\-train ML models capable of reasoning over complex geometric and engineering design data.
* Collaborate directly with enterprise customers to ensure AI\-powered workflows are reliable and trusted in production.


**The ideal candidate**
* Holds a degree in Computer Science or Machine Learning with strong proficiency in LLM architectures and agent research.
* Proven track record of building and shipping production\-grade ML systems using PyTorch or Hugging Face.
* Exceptional programming skills with practical experience in search, information retrieval, or geometric data processing.


**Who are Jack \& Jill?**
 Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
   

  

 And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
   

  

**How does this work?**
* Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
* Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
* If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


**We never post fake jobs**
 This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
   

  

 Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
   

  

 We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
   

  

 Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

**About The Job**
 Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
   

  

 The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
   

  

 We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
   

  

 The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $147,000\-$211,000 \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. title: Junior Data Scientist
description_preview:
**WHO WE ARE** 




  





 TIFIN builds the AI operating layer for wealth. Our platform delivers agentic workflows across the industry’s core personas—investors, advisors, investment teams, and operations—so financial institutions can move faster, serve more clients, and deliver better outcomes with the same (or fewer) resources. We combine finance\-native AI, specialized data, and enterprise\-grade controls to deploy secure, compliant capabilities into real production environments.
 



  





**WHAT SETS US APART** 




  




* **Speed:** 
 We build and ship quickly—MVPs in \~3 months, production\-ready products in \~6–12 months.
* **Track Record:** 
 Prior exits include 55ip (acquired by J.P. Morgan) and Paralel
* **Strategic Partners:** 
 Partners include J.P. Morgan, SEI, Franklin Templeton, Morningstar, Broadridge, Motive Partners and Tectonic Ventures.
* **World\-Class Team:** 
 Complimentary expertise across AI and financial services, with experience from Google, Microsoft, Uber, PayPal, eBay, BlackRock, LPL, Franklin Templeton, Morgan Stanley, Broadridge and more.



  





**OUR VALUES** 




  




* **Grow at the Edge.** 
 We are driven by personal growth fueled by a beginner’s mindset. We get out of our comfort zone and keep egos aside. With self\-awareness and integrity we strive to be the best we can possibly be. No excuses.
* **Understanding through Listening and Speaking the Truth.** 
 We communicate with authenticity, precision and integrity to create a shared understanding. We identify opportunities within constraints and propose solutions in service to the team.
* **I Win for Teamwin.** 
 We believe in staying within our genius zones to succeed and taking accountability for driving results. We are all individual contributors first and always thinking about what can be better.



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




  





 As a Junior Data Scientist, you will contribute to the ML growth engine behind TIFIN AMP — a production machine learning platform driving acquisition, expansion, retention, and distribution intelligence across wealth enterprises and asset managers. This is an individual contributor role with close collaboration with senior data scientists, engineering, and customer success. You will gain hands\-on exposure across the full ML lifecycle while growing your skills in a fast\-moving, finance\-native AI environment.
 



  





**PROJECTS** 




  




* **Client Retention \& Churn Prevention.** 
 Support the development of early\-warning models that detect signals of potential client attrition, allowing advisors to proactively intervene.
* **Asset Consolidation.** 
 Contribute to predictive models that identify clients most likely to consolidate additional assets, enabling advisors to deepen relationships and increase AUM.
* **Cross\-Sell \& Wallet Share Growth.** 
 Assist in designing models that identify high\-propensity opportunities for additional products and services within existing client relationships.
* **Advisor \& Prospect Prioritization** 
 . Help build scoring frameworks that rank advisors and prospects by growth potential, enabling sales teams to focus on the most impactful opportunities.
* **Product–Advisor Matching.** 
 Support the development of models that predict product–advisor fit and likelihood of engagement, improving targeting and accelerating product adoption.



  





**WHAT YOU’LL DO** 




  




* Participate in the full ML lifecycle under senior guidance: EDA → feature engineering → training → validation → deployment → monitoring.
* Support end\-to\-end model implementation for one or more enterprise clients.
* Help engineer feature pipelines across AUM, transactions, CRM, and third\-party datasets.
* Work with AWS (SageMaker, Redshift, S3\) and/or Snowflake environments.
* Assist in designing A/B tests and control frameworks to measure lift in inflows and conversion.
* Translate model outputs into clear, actionable intelligence used daily by advisors and wholesalers.



  





**WHAT YOU’LL BRING** 




  




* 1–2\+ years of experience in data science, ML engineering, or a related quantitative field (internships and academic projects count).
* Foundational supervised learning knowledge and eagerness to deepen it in production environments.
* Exposure to consumer behavior modeling, time\-series, or lifecycle analytics is a plus.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL; familiarity with AWS or Snowflake is a bonus.
* Strong communication skills and a bias toward shipping measurable, tangible impact.
* Curiosity, humility, and a desire to learn fast in a collaborative, high\-growth environment.



  





**COMPENSATION RANGE** 




  





 $100,000 \- $125,000 USD
 



  





 In addition to cash compensation, a meaningful equity stake is a significant part of the overall package. Package also includes benefits program eligibility: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits and flexible PTO.
 



  





*TIFIN is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and values the multitude of talents and perspectives that a diverse workforce brings. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.*

 here.*

title: AWS Full Stack Software Engineer - Integrations Platform, Enterprise Supervision
description_preview:
**Description**
 Join the Enterprise Supervision team at Tyler Technologies as a Software Engineer supporting our Integrations Platform. You'll be working alongside a tight\-knit team of engineers and architects who have designed and built our next\-generation, event\-driven integrations platform from the ground up. We're looking for a skilled developer with strong TypeScript experience who is also comfortable working in Golang.
   

  

 In this role, you'll help design and evolve scalable serverless microservices, shared libraries, and integration patterns that connect product domains across our platform. If you enjoy working asynchronously, writing thoughtful design docs, and solving hard integration problems at scale, this is the team for you.
   

  

 Hybrid Work Policy: This position requires a minimum of 3 days per week in our Plano, TX office.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and maintain AWS serverless microservices using Lambda, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, Step Functions, API Gateway, and EventBridge.
* Develop and evolve shared TypeScript libraries covering config management, observability, HTTP client, and schema contracts consumed across services.
* Author and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS SAM and CloudFormation.
* Implement event\-driven integration patterns that enable interoperability across product domains.
* Write and maintain unit and integration tests using Vitest; leverage LocalStack for local AWS service emulation.
* Participate in Architecture Reviews for breaking changes and contribute to design discussions.
* Manage package versioning and releases via Changesets and GitHub Packages.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with QA, Product, and DevOps teams within Agile development cycles.


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of professional TypeScript/Node.js development experience.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS serverless services including Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, API Gateway, and Step Functions.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, with AWS SAM or CloudFormation preferred.
* Solid understanding of event\-driven and integration\-centric architecture pattern.
* Experience working in a monorepo with pnpm workspaces or similar tooling (Nx, Turborepo).
* Comfortable with semantic versioning, changesets, and package publishing workflows.
* Familiarity with observability tooling including structured logging, distributed tracing, and metrics (AWS Powertools a plus).
* Experience writing tests with Vitest, Jest, or similar; comfortable with local cloud emulation using LocalStack
* Familiarity with JSON Schema, runtime validation libraries (Zod, AJV), or schema registry patterns.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* Strong written communication skills.


**Preferred Skills**
* Prior work on government, justice, or public safety software platforms.
* Familiarity with AWS Cognito and IAM\-based authentication patterns.
* Exposure to data transformation and mapping systems such as JSONata or JSONPath.

description_preview:

 At the Outdoorsy Group, we've already revolutionized how people experience the open road. Now, at
 **Roamly Labs** 
 https://www.roamlylabs.ai/.
   

  

 The Labs is our dedicated innovation and incubation arm—we are building the next generation of intelligent infrastructure for the future of travel, mobility, and protection.
   

  

 Roamly Labs is where cutting\-edge technology meets real\-world application. We don't just experiment with AI; we build production\-ready, AI\-native systems that solve massive, complex challenges across embedded insurance, autonomous mobility, and real\-time telemetry. If you want to move fast, break paradigms, and build the future of the outdoor and mobility ecosystems, you belong here.

 We are seeking an extraordinary
 **AI Engineer** 
 who is an AI\-native builder at heart. You aren't just a consumer of APIs; you possess a deep engineering foundation combined with a highly creative, driven DNA.

* Revolutionize Embedded Insurance: Develop AI\-driven products through agents that power solutions we are innovating for the embedded insurance and autonomous mobility markets
* Pioneer Telemetry \& FSD Integration: Architect highly scalable AI systems that process real\-time vehicle telemetry, working seamlessly alongside Full Self\-Driving (FSD) and autonomous mobility systems
* Rapid Prototyping to Production: Turn audacious ideas into functional MVPs within days, and scale them into robust, production\-grade enterprise solutions
* Drive an AI\-Native Culture: Stay on the absolute bleeding edge of generative AI, LLMs, computer vision, and reinforcement learning, injecting an innovative mindset into every layer of our tech stack


**Who You Are (Candidate Profile)**
* The AI\-Native Mindset: You think in terms of agentic workflows, embeddings, vector databases, and cognitive architectures. You view AI not as an add\-on, but as the foundational core of modern software
* Strong Engineering DNA: You have a proven track record of shipping production\-grade software. You understand the nuances of MLOps, LLMOps, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)
* Domain Curiosity: While you don't need to be an expert in all of them today, you are deeply eager to master the intersection of InsurTech, autonomous mobility, and IoT/telemetry data
* Creative \& Driven: You possess a high degree of autonomy, a bias for action, and the creative problem\-solving skills required to navigate ambiguous, zero\-to\-one product spaces
* Location: Based in or willing to relocate to Austin, TX, ready to collaborate closely with the team in our innovation hub


**Bonus Points If You Have...**
* Experience working with sensor fusion, geospatial data, Agentic systems or time\-series telemetry from connected vehicles
* Deep familiarity with agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) or custom\-built cognitive loops
* A portfolio of side projects, open\-source contributions, or hackathon wins that demonstrate your passion for building


**Benefits**
**What We Offer**
* The opportunity to shape the future of a multi\-billion\-dollar industry backed by the resources of the Outdoorsy Group
* A high\-autonomy, low\-bureaucracy environment designed for builders
* Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits
* A vibrant workspace in Austin, TX, surrounded by a world\-class team of innovators


**Are you ready to build what's next?** 
 Apply to Roamly Labs today and help us drive the future of autonomous mobility and embedded insurance.

title: Prototype Engineer
description_preview:
**About Us**
 Higharc is a VC\-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised a total of $83M with support from top\-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors—industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.
   

  

 Higharc is seeking a
 **Prototyping Engineer** 
 to join our rapidly growing Special Projects team. In this role, you'll take foundational AI/ML research and integrate new capabilities into the Higharc platform.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Operating in lock\-step with our broader engineering organization, this engineer will test prototypes with customers, evaluate results, and promote proven capabilities to the full product.
 *Expect to:*
* Design and develop tools that expose AI/ML capabilities to autonomous agents, building the orchestration layer that solves complex domain use\-cases in production homebuilding.
* Take proven research outputs and integrate them into the Higharc product as packages and components, following best practices established in a large, complex codebase.
* Work across the Python ML/AI service layer and the TypeScript/React product, wiring new capabilities end\-to\-end via API.
* Build frameworks for rapid evaluation, iteration, and promotion of prototypes.
* Operate in lock\-step with the broader engineering organization and participate in customer\-facing labs sessions, using direct customer signal to validate prototypes and inform iteration priorities.
* Serve as the primary translation layer between the research team and the product engineering team.
* Convert experimental notebooks, fine\-tuned models, and RAG pipelines into maintainable, testable, deployable code.
* Develop working knowledge of the homebuilding domain sufficient to make independent judgment calls about which capabilities matter, which edge\-cases are load\-bearing, and where AI falls short in the built environment.


**About You**
 You're an empathetic and high\-impact engineer who bridges the gap between research output and production software. You believe that homebuilding is a real and complex domain worth understanding deeply, not a generic vertical to slap AI onto. You have excellent judgement and collaboration skills, and treat the boundary between reesarch and product as shared territory, not "someone else's problem".
   

  

*You have:*
* 4\+ years of professional Software Engineering experience, with 2\+ years integrating ML/AI capabilities into production products
* Shipped AI\-powered features to real users, not just model training
* Experience working in or adjacent to a research team
* Professional proficiency with Python, Typescript/React, API design, LLM tooling, evaluation design, and AI calibration
* Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open\-source), vector databases, RAG architectures, Python ML ecosystem (PyTorch, HuggingFace), modern frontend frameworks (React/Next.js), CI/CD and testing frameworks


*A major plus if you also bring:*
* Experience in construction, AEC, or other physical\-world domains with messy, under\-structured data
* Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, or custom harnesses) strongly preferred


*While we've identified the core experience and skills required above, please still apply if you have more or different experience than this! We will use your previous experience and performance across the series of interviews to establish appropriate level within our organization in a fair and equitable way.*
 Working at Higharc
   

  

 Higharc has been remote first since our founding in 2018\. We offer flexible hours so you can do your best work without missing out on life. Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast\-growing, well\-funded company.
   

  

 Personal healthiness is an important value for us\- we provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with unlimited PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full\-time. You'll also have access to other big\-company benefits such like short and long\-term disability plans and a 401K. Haven't worked remotely before? We provide a stipend to create the ideal home office.

title: Software Engineer II, Backend Full Stack - HR Product
description_preview:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The HR Product Team**
 The HR Product Engineering team is the foundational layer of Rippling's unified workforce management system. Our mission is to build seamless, global, and compliant systems that power the entire employee lifecycle, from hire to retire.
   

  

 We operate at the critical intersection of HR, compliance, and enterprise software. Our products manage the most sensitive and essential aspects of a company's relationship with its people, requiring us to solve complex problems related to scale, data security, and multi\-product integration.
   

  

**What We Build**
 The team is composed of high\-impact squads focused on four core domains:
   

  

* HRIS (Human Resources Information System): Building the core employee record, organizational structure, and workflows that serve as the single source of truth for all other Rippling products.
* Time: Developing accurate, scalable, and globally compliant Time \& Attendance systems, including clocking, time\-off accrual, and scheduling, ensuring employees are paid correctly and legally.
* Benefits: Creating and maintaining the marketplace and administration tools for health, retirement, and other employee benefits, handling complex enrollment, eligibility, and provider integrations.
* Talent: Designing products that manage employee growth, performance, and learning, helping companies develop and retain their workforce effectively.


**What You Will Do**
* Design and implement features with an emphasis on backend logic, API development, and data integrity, while also contributing to the frontend implementation.
* Work across the stack, focusing on API design, event modeling, and robust data management while ensuring a seamless connection to the user interface.
* Own the full development lifecycle for features, ensuring that the backend architecture supports both reliable functionality and excellent frontend performance.
* Work closely with cross\-functional partners to understand requirements, refine technical scope, and drive successful, reliable feature delivery.


**What You Will Need**
* 2\+ years of professional experience with a focus on full\-stack development, demonstrating the ability to deliver reliable, end\-to\-end products using a backend language (e.g., Python/Go) and frontend technologies like React/TypeScript.
* Prioritize projects based on business impact, ensuring high\-quality implementation without unnecessary complexity.
* Ability to thrive in dynamic environments, quickly switching context between frontend and backend work as needed to accelerate delivery.
* Excellent skills in communicating technical trade\-offs across the stack with clarity and precision to both frontend and backend partners.

**When joining Elevations, you can expect to work for a company with:**
* A leadership team that strives to make this the best place you’ve ever worked!
* A focus on supporting our employees’ mental, physical, and financial well\-being
* A commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion recognized by the Denver Business Journal and Colorado Association of Realtors
* A highly engaged workforce devoted to innovation, continuous improvement, and collaboration
* A reputation for excellence, as evidenced by being a two\-time recipient of the Malcolm Baldrige National Quality Award
* A passion for consistently providing amazing experiences and creating raving fans


**If you join our team, here are some of the perks you can expect:**
* A competitive total rewards package with 4 weeks paid time off for full\-time employees, work anniversary paid time off, paid volunteer time off, and 12 paid holidays
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans with employer contributions to supercharge your Health Savings Account
* Up to a 4% match on 401(k) contributions
* Up to twelve weeks of fully paid parental leave
* An extensive Employee Assistance Program that provides personalized care options for your whole household
* Ample opportunity to learn, develop and grow with access to LinkedIn Learning, career and leadership development programs, job shadowing, a mentor program, and tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year


**Location:**
 Broomfield, CO \- Elevations Basecamp
   

  

 This role can be performed on site at the location above, or
 **remotely for any individual who resides in the state of Colorado.**
**Summary/Objective:**
 The Application Developer provides top quality solutions that meet application solution needs of Elevations Credit Union business line departments. This is a journey level role responsible for translating software requirements into well\-designed solutions; working with 'off the shelf' software, modifying it and integrating it into the existing architecture; and maintaining programs for business applications.
   

  

**Essential Functions:**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for system enhancements and optimizations.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Create, analyze, review, and modify programs for data processing and applications using JHA Symitar PowerOn programming language.
* Collaborates with third\-party vendors to ensure the seamless implementation, maintenance, and support of software and hardware that integrates with Symitar and other applications.
* Utilizes sound software development life cycle (SDLC) practices and accurately follows established procedures for delivering application solutions that support critical business strategies.
* Perform code reviews and ensure compliance with coding standards and best practices.
* Troubleshoots issues and resolving incidents in support of existing production applications and initiates action to correct quality problems or notifies others of issues as appropriate.


**Reports to:**
 Application Development Manager
   

  

**Manages:**
 This role does not have supervisory responsibility.
   

  

**Required Education and Experience:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or other related field or equivalent work experience.
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages supporting enterprise financial institution platforms.
* Two (2\) years of experience in a financial institution developing and supporting business applications environments.
* Demonstrated knowledge of architecture / systems engineering best practices, systems process design, software design, programming principles, or equivalent processes.
* Fundamental understanding of and experience with at least one of the following areas: Retail Operations, Lending Operations, Financial Backoffice Operations.


**Preferred Skills, Education, and Experience:**
* Four (4\) year's' experience with financial institution technologies: FIS, Fiserv, FIS – Corelation KeyStone, Finastra, Jack Henry (Symitar, Synapsys, Synergy, SymXchange, ARCU), Alkami, COTS, Image Center, OpCon, etc.
* Technical hands\-on experience with Jack Henry Symitar proprietary programming (PowerOn/RepGen), SQL development for relational databases, HTML, and Java Script.
* Ability to program in at least one programming language, such as C\#, Java, PHP, COBOL, or RPG, HTML, JavaScript etc.
* Familiarity with the Unix operating system, Unix shell scripting, Python, or similar.
* Command of one or more scripting languages (PowerShell, Bash).
* Project management experience in an iterative project management methodology. Ie. Agile, Scum, Kanban
* Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) certification, or previous work within an ITIL environment.


**Work Environment:**
 Elevations uses multi\-factor authentication to keep our data safe. As such, a personal smart phone is a requirement for employment with us. This job operates in an office setting and routinely uses standard office equipment.
   

  

**Physical Requirements:**
 Sitting frequently, walking occasionally, use of hands frequently, hearing constantly, talking frequently, exerting up to 10 lbs of force occasionally to lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects.
   

  

**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:**
 Full time / 40 hours per week
   

  

**Classification:**
 Exempt
   

  

**Compensation:**
 The person hired into this position will likely earn between $77,618\.50 and $97,023\.13, plus annual bonus.
   

  

 Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted hiring range based on factors such as relevant experience, time in role, base salary of internal peers, prior performance, business sector, licensure requirements and/or skill level, and will be finalized at the time of offer.
   

  

**Anticipated Application Window:**
 This role is anticipated to close within 45 days from the date of posting. However, if the position has not been filled, Elevations may keep the application period open longer.
   

  

**Other Duties:**
 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
   

  

**About Us:** 
 Elevations Credit Union is a member\-owned not\-for\-profit financial institution serving Colorado’s Front Range. Founded in 1952, we’ve grown from 12 members and less than $100 in assets to an institution with 15 branches and more than 170,000 members that manages over $3 billion in assets and is the No. 1 credit union mortgage lender in Colorado. At Elevations, we’ve made a commitment to move away from a product\-centered business model and focus instead on creating consumer solutions. Our objective is to provide our members, as well as the entire community, with unbiased consumer information.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 The Credit Union is dedicated to the principles of equal employment opportunity. We prohibit unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees on the basis of age 40 and over, race (including traits historically associated with race, such as hair texture and length, protective hairstyles), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, disability, military status, genetic information, marital status, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

If the position you are applying for requires a credit history report, any information received in such a report will not be the sole factor in making an employment decision. A history of personal financial irresponsibility may be reason for disqualification insofar as it relates to your potential job duties. Elevations Credit Union is aware that occasionally there are extenuating circumstances that may affect an individual's credit history. We comply with the Fair Credit Reporting Act and the Colorado Employment Opportunity Act.

 Your privacy is important to us. When you use this Careers site to apply for a job at Elevations Credit Union (“we” and “us”), we collect your personal information. title: Robot Engineering Intern
description_preview:
Our team is hiring a few robot engineering interns for this summer at our office in Silicon Valley.
 



 Because these roles require significant hands\-on time with physical humanoid hardware, you must be based in or willing to relocate to the Bay Area for the duration of the internship. We are open to BS, MS, or PhD candidates.
 



  





 We are bypassing standard ROS 2 wrappers for our core communication layer and building a low\-latency network using Zenoh, CycloneDDS, and ZMQ to drive a Unitree G1 platform. We are highly interested in students with backgrounds in RL, VLAs, or imitation learning; even though this is an infrastructure and platform role, you need to understand exactly what the data pipelines and control loops must support downstream.
 



  





 What you will own:
 


* Direct teleoperation infrastructure development and QA testing on physical hardware.
* Platform\-level engineering for the Unitree G1, focusing on maximizing pipeline determinism and minimizing end\-to\-end latency.
* Building and scaling data infrastructure (logging, serialization, tokenization) designed specifically to feed downstream VLA and imitation learning models.
* Optimizing and tuning Whole\-Body Control (WBC) and kinematics to ensure the platform is robust enough to support future policy deployment.



  





 What we look for:
 


* Strong proficiency in Python and modern C\+\+.
* Experience or strong familiarity with RL, VLAs, foundation models, or imitation learning pipelines (giving you the foresight to build the right data infrastructure).
* Solid grounding in rigid\-body kinematics, linear algebra, and control theory (WBC/IK).
* Experience with major physics engines (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim) for infrastructure validation.



  





 If you are interested, please submit your resume and a cover letter with a brief description of the most complex robotics, simulation, or data infrastructure pipeline you have personally built. For any questions, please reach out to careers@toborlife.ai.

title: Solutions Engineer, SELECT by DoiT
description_preview:
**Location:** 
 Our Solutions Engineer, SELECT by DoiT, will be an integral part of our Solutions Engineering team in North America. This role is based remotely in the US East.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 DoiT is a global technology company that empowers cloud\-driven organizations to achieve business growth and innovation through strategic cloud utilization. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well\-architected and scalable state—from initial planning to full\-scale production.
   

  

 With deep experience across cloud environments, we specialize in Cloud Data Platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery, alongside strong FinOps expertise. As a trusted and award\-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we support over 4,000 customers worldwide.
   

  

 Our flagship offerings include DoiT Cloud Intelligence, which uniquely blends advanced technology with human insight to solve complex multicloud challenges and drive efficiency. We also offer SELECT for Snowflake—a pioneering solution for cost observability and optimization (with Databricks and BigQuery support coming soon). By automating optimizations and delivering actionable cost\-saving insights, SELECT enables organizations to achieve unparalleled efficiency across their Cloud Data Platforms.
   

  

***The SELECT platform offers:***
* Automated savings on day one: An autonomous optimization engine that suspends idle compute and spins down excess clusters without requiring engineering time, saving customers 10\-20% with minimal human intervention.
* Targeted insights that stack\-rank savings opportunities: Actionable recommendations that surface oversized resources, inefficient queries, and unused tables, prioritized by savings potential so teams know exactly where to focus.
* Full cost visibility, down to the workload: Granular attribution across queries, jobs, teams, and departments, giving organizations the context to compare Cloud Data Platform spend against the business value provided.
* Cost control and spike prevention: Budget tracking, forecast tooling, and configurable alerts that not only notify teams of runaway spend but immediately surface root cause analysis, eliminating the need to jump between consoles.
* AI\-powered investigation that turns hours into minutes: A built\-in copilot that accelerates MTTR, frees engineering teams from reactive firefighting, and provides a sustainable path to cost\-aware culture across the business.


**The Opportunity**
 As a Solutions Engineer, SELECT by DoiT, you will be a pivotal technical leader, collaborating closely with our Account Executive team to deliver exceptional value throughout the customer journey, specifically focusing on our cutting\-edge Snowflake/Databricks optimization capabilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Technical Qualification \& Discovery: Collaborating with the Account Executive to thoroughly understand the prospect's technical environment, Cloud Data Platform cost challenges, cost optimization goals, and key business objectives through in\-depth technical discovery sessions.
* Technical Validation \& POV Leadership: Owning and driving the technical validation and Proof of Value (POV) exercises for SELECT. This includes meticulous POC preparation, proactive management, and ensuring successful technical outcomes, demonstrating clear value and alignment with prospect requirements.
* Platform Demonstrations: Tailoring and delivering compelling SELECT platform demonstrations to prospects, effectively showcasing its capabilities and addressing their specific use cases and concerns.
* Business Case \& ROI Development: Leveraging your analytical skills and deep understanding of Cloud Data Platform to develop compelling business cases and robust ROI analyses that clearly articulate the tangible value, cost savings, and performance improvements achievable with SELECT.
* SELECT Expertise: Becoming the go\-to expert within the company for SELECT, ensuring prospects achieve optimal results and a seamless implementation experience.
* Technical Win Ownership: Taking full ownership of the technical win for SELECT engagements, guiding prospects through the technical evaluation process, addressing all technical requirements, and building technical confidence in the solution.
* Event \& Conference Presentations: Representing DoiT and SELECT at company events and industry conferences, delivering engaging presentations and demonstrations to a wider audience, showcasing our Snowflake/Databricks (and soon BigQuery) optimization expertise as well as platform capabilities.
* Product Feedback and Customer Advocacy: Translate customer pain points and feature gaps into structured, technically credible input for R\&D teams. Represent the voice of the technical customer in roadmap discussions.
* Accurate, timely documentation: Ensure timely entry of data into internal business support solutions. Contribute to systems and tools to provide key business information and metrics to highlight performance and effectiveness.


 We are seeking an individual who is not only passionate about Snowflake/Databricks/BigQuery optimization but also thrives on engaging technically with customers, solving their most pressing challenges related to Cloud Data Platform cost and performance. This role offers the exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of innovation within a rapidly evolving ecosystem.
   

  

**About You**
 You are an accomplished Solutions Engineer with a proven track record in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally with a strong emphasis on Snowflake/Databricks/BigQuery solutions. You excel as a technical leader within a sales team and are enthusiastic about empowering companies to optimize their Cloud Data Platform environments for maximum cost efficiency and performance through innovative solutions like SELECT. You are highly accountable for the technical success of all initiatives you are involved in and are driven to contribute to a high\-performing sales organization that consistently wins in a competitive market. You are comfortable and thrive in a fast\-paced, growing, collaborative, and entrepreneurial setting.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in a Solutions Engineering role within a B2B SaaS software company, having a significant portion of that experience focused on selling to Snowflake, Databricks and BigQuery users and directly addressing challenges related to Cloud Data Platforms or cloud cost management.
* Deep and demonstrable understanding of Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery as well as associated best practices
* Hands\-on experience working with SaaS solutions focusing on Cloud Data Platforms in the areas of observability, optimization, FinOps, or data integration.
* Exceptional data analysis skills with a proven ability to identify key trends, outliers, and correlations as well as the translation of those observations into actionable insights.
* Strong track record of leveraging product data to construct compelling business cases and ROI justifications for prospective customers, clearly demonstrating the substantial cost savings and performance enhancements achievable through our solution.
* Exceptional ability to articulate complex Cloud Data Platform related concepts and SELECT functionalities in a clear, concise, and easily understandable manner to both technical and business audiences.
* Outstanding verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills, with the confidence and expertise to present on sophisticated topics such as Cloud Data Platform optimization strategies and the compelling value proposition of SELECT.
* Strong intellectual curiosity, exceptional problem\-solving abilities, and a genuine passion for continuous learning and improvement within the dynamic Snowflake/Databricks/BigQuery ecosystem.
* Proven experience working with and presenting to executive\-level prospects and customers on critical topics related to Cloud Data Platforms and especially cost management.
* Demonstrated experience with modern technical selling best practices/methodologies and a successful track record in competitive sales environments, including the ability to contribute to and implement effective trial, demo, and RFP processes specifically tailored for Cloud Data Platform optimization solutions like SELECT.
* Prior professional experience as a Snowflake/Databricks/BigQuery data engineer/architect or FinOps professional is a plus.
* A proven history of success in a fast\-paced and scaling business, ideally within the Cloud Data Platform ecosystem.


**Are you a Do’er?**
 Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
   

  

 We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.
   

  

 What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.
   

  

 Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.
   

  

 We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.
   

  

 Full\-time employee benefits include:
   

  

* Unlimited Vacation
* Flexible Working Options
* Health Insurance
* Parental Leave
* Employee Stock Option Plan
* Home Office Allowance
* Professional Development Stipend
* Peer Recognition Program


**Many Do’ers, One Team**
 DoiT unites as
 *Many Do’ers, One Team* 
 , where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

description_preview:
**This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.**
 She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.
   

  

 The next step is to speak to Jack.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Product Engineer
   

  

**Salary**
 Not Disclosed
   

  

**Company Description**
 Government\-tech startup modernizing housing and permitting infrastructure
   

  

**Job Description**
 Join a mission\-driven founding team of twelve to solve the housing crisis by digitizing government permitting. As an early\-career engineer, you will build end\-to\-end features using TypeScript, React, and Node.js. You’ll own product decisions, collaborate directly with high\-profile government agencies, and ship code that accelerates urban development and housing availability.
   

  

**Location**
 San Francisco, USA
   

  

**Why this role is remarkable**
* Work on a mission with tangible real\-world impact: making housing happen faster by rebuilding archaic government paper\-based systems.
* High\-visibility traction with flagship customers including the San Francisco Planning Department and the State of Delaware already onboarded.
* Exceptional mentorship within a small, \~12\-person founding team where junior engineers have high ownership and direct influence on the product roadmap.


**What You Will Do**
* Build and ship full\-stack features end\-to\-end using TypeScript, React, Remix, Node.js, Prisma, Postgres, and AWS.
* Engage directly with government agency end\-users to gather feedback, understand complex workflows, and translate them into digital solutions.
* Participate in product strategy and architectural decisions, moving beyond ticket execution to solve ambiguous, founding\-stage engineering challenges.


**The ideal candidate**
* Early\-career engineer with strong foundations in TypeScript and modern web frameworks like React or Node.js.
* Demonstrated ability to thrive in high\-stakes, ambiguous environments where you need to manage your own projects and prioritize user needs.
* Passionate about urbanism, public infrastructure, or civic tech, with a desire to see code translate into real\-world physical housing improvements.


**Who are Jack \& Jill?**
 Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
   

  

 And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
   

  

**How does this work?**
* Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
* Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
* If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


**We never post fake jobs**
 This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
   

  

 Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
   

  

 We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
   

  

 Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

**Responsibilities**
* Design, architect, and develop simulation models, visualization tools, virtual environments, and frameworks to improve test performance, safety, and durability of hardware and software systems.

* Perform comprehensive design, modeling, simulation, testing, and analysis to evaluate and optimize system performance and capabilities.
* Collect, process, and analyze data to support simulation accuracy and validation efforts.

* Manage simulation software projects, including planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring adherence to quality standards and timelines.

Eligibility for these benefits varies based on geographic location, employment status, and other factors.
   

  

 We are committed to supporting our employees’ well\-being and professional development, providing resources and programs that promote work\-life balance, continuous learning, and career advancement.  This role is ideal for engineers who have built production systems at companies like Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Meta, or similar high\-scale engineering organizations. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance AI\-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong expertise in systems programming, infrastructure, or backend development using languages like Python, C/C\+\+, Rust, and Go.

* Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales.

The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride\-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. Their work ensures the fleet stays efficient, riders get fast pickups, and the AV network operates safely and profitably across cities.
   

  

 The Pricing team drives Waymo's revenue and business strategy by developing dynamic pricing algorithms that balance supply and demand in real\-time. Their work is critical to navigating the complexities of ride\-hailing dynamics, balancing user price sensitivity with operational efficiency.
